cards.name: Atlas
cards.description: Finds small local businesses via Google Maps (vertical x metro queries), applies exclusion filters, learns from per-query yield feedback.

cards.name: Scout
cards.description: Scores ICP/intent/budget/reachability/timing 0-100 with a deterministic rubric, explains every score, tiers HOT/WARM/NURTURE.

cards.name: Enrichment
cards.description: Finds + verifies emails and Instagram handles (Hunter -> web search -> agentic decide-next-query loop), never invents data.

cards.name: Outreach
cards.description: Drafts Gemini-personalized emails/IG DMs with an evaluator-optimizer revise loop, queues WARM drafts for approval, sends approved sends (50/run email cap, 15/24h IG cap, lint-before-send).

cards.name: Followups
cards.description: Sends Day 3/7/14 follow-ups from the CRM, polishes copy with Gemini.

cards.name: Inbound
cards.description: Scans email for lead replies, triages with a bounded classify-act-escalate loop (keyword STOP floor, CRM-history tool), escalates to the owner.
